parsed.note_claim: The video originates from a 2024 TikTok posted by the mother, showing her 4-year-old daughter (born premature) holding her premature newborn sibling, and no death occurred.

parsed.quote: The video was originally shared on TikTok by a Vietnamese woman named Bảo Ngọc, who clarified that the child in the video is her daughter, not the mother of the baby. The clip shows her two premature babies, and the older child in the video is the babies' sister, not her mother.
